CustomField.description: Shows the variance between the actual revenue for both Domestic/International and the respective target revenues.
CustomField.formula: IF( is_Current_FY__c=true, IF ( ISPICKVAL(Network__c, "Domestic"), Account_Name__r.QF_Domestic_Revenue__c - QF_Rev_Target_MAT__c, Account_Name__r.QF_International_Revenue__c - QF_Rev_Target_MAT__c ) , null)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Moving Annual Total revenue variance by network
CustomField.label: Revenue Var (MAT)
